content.user_title: Mine Paid Search Terms for Growth and Waste
content.value_statement: Paid search exports hide converting queries and costly non-converting patterns. This skill turns them into keyword additions, negatives, n-gram waste rankings, and maintenance actions.
actual_capabilities: Checks exports for query, cost, conversion, and optional conversion-value columns.
Identifies converting queries that are not represented by existing keywords.
Routes useful queries to keyword additions, ad-group additions, or moves.
Proposes exact or phrase negatives for costly queries without conversions.
Ranks costly non-converting one-, two-, and three-word query patterns.
Produces a maintenance diff and a supported spend-efficiency score.
limitations: Requires a search-terms export with query, cost, and conversion data.
Does not redesign account structure or allocate budgets and bids.
Does not calculate the final account-level RQS.
Optional analytics validation depends on user-provided exports or configured connectors.

use_cases.title: Reduce Weekly Search Waste
use_cases.description: Review a fresh search-terms export and propose negatives for costly queries without conversions.

use_cases.title: Expand Proven Keyword Coverage
use_cases.description: Turn converting customer queries into keyword additions and identify missing intent groups.

use_cases.title: Audit Query-Level Efficiency
use_cases.description: Rank wasteful n-grams and document measured evidence for spend-efficiency review.

prompt_templates.title: Find Negative Keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this search-terms export: [paste or path]. Use [cost floor] and list zero-conversion queries that should become exact or phrase negatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of wasted search spend

prompt_templates.title: Harvest Converting Queries
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this export for queries with at least [conversion threshold] conversions. Separate new keywords, ad-group additions, and moves from existing coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Keyword expansion from proven query demand

prompt_templates.title: Build an N-Gram Waste Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze non-converting queries above [cost floor]. Rank costly one-, two-, and three-word patterns, then propose suitable shared-list negatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Recurring pattern analysis across many queries

prompt_templates.title: Produce the Full Maintenance Diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the [profile] profile on this export and existing keyword structure. Deliver add, negate, and move actions, plus measured n-gram waste and spend-efficiency notes.

output_examples.input: A search-terms export with query, cost, conversions, and existing keyword coverage.
output_examples.output: Maintenance summary: add seven converting queries, move two queries to closer intent groups, and negate twelve costly zero-conversion queries with stated match types.

output_examples.input: A monthly export with many non-converting queries and a cost floor of 25.
output_examples.output: Waste summary: the highest-cost recurring phrases are ranked by measured spend, with campaign-level or shared-list negative recommendations for each suitable pattern.

output_examples.input: A prospecting profile export with conversion value and existing negatives.
output_examples.output: Efficiency summary: measured waste share, supported spend-efficiency notes, new keyword themes, negative-list changes, and unresolved data gaps are clearly separated.

best_practices: Provide a recent export with query, cost, conversions, and conversion value when available.
State the campaign goal, profile, conversion threshold, and minimum wasted-spend threshold.
Review proposed negatives for valuable intent before applying them to campaigns.
anti_patterns: Do not create negatives from clicks alone when conversion data is missing.
Do not use this skill to redesign account structure or assign budgets.
Do not treat modeled or estimated values as measured export data.

faq.question: Which columns are required?
faq.answer: Query, cost, and conversions are required. Conversion value is also needed for ROAS-based scoring.

faq.question: Can it work without a file path?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the search-terms rows directly if they include the required columns.

faq.question: Does it apply changes to an ad account?
faq.answer: No. It produces proposed additions, negatives, and moves for user review.

faq.question: How are negative match types selected?
faq.answer: The skill proposes exact or phrase negatives based on query specificity and recurring wasted intent.

faq.question: Can it design new campaign structure?
faq.answer: No. It identifies structure gaps and hands them to the campaign architecture workflow.

faq.question: How often should the analysis run?
faq.answer: Run it weekly or monthly using a fresh export and consistent decision thresholds.
